releases.notes:
# XenAddons v1.5.0

Minecraft `26.1.2` • `26.2` • `26.3` • Fabric • Java `25+`

## Added

- **Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3 support**
  - XenAddons now ships one jar per Minecraft version: `xenaddons-1.5.0-mc26.1.2.jar`, `xenaddons-1.5.0-mc26.2.jar` and `xenaddons-1.5.0-mc26.3.jar`. Pick the one that matches your game.
  - Every feature is available on all three versions.

- **Compact Stash** (MISC)
  - Replaces Hypixel's stash reminders (`You have X items stashed away!`, the material version with its totals line, and `One or more items didn't fit in your inventory…`) with a single line: `Item Stash > You have X items stashed away!`, or `Material Stash >` for materials.
  - The line is clickable and runs `/pickupstash` directly instead of opening `/viewstash`.
  - The empty lines Hypixel puts around the reminder are removed as well.

- **Invincibility Display** (DUNGEONS)
  - HUD showing the Spirit Mask, Bonzo's Mask and Phoenix Pet heads, each with its invincibility time in gold, its cooldown in red, or a green ✔ when it's ready. Based on Odin's Invincibility Timer.
  - Bonzo's Mask cooldown is read from your helmet's lore when available.
  - "Displayed Items" chooses which of the three are shown. "Invincibility Hud" holds the HUD toggle, a "Show" mode (Always, Any, When Active, On Cooldown) and the "Equipped Mask" color.
  - A small bar in that color marks what will save you: the mask you're wearing, or the Phoenix when it's your active pet and you have no mask on.
  - The heads use your skins: Panda and Wisp for the Spirit Mask, Jester for Bonzo's Mask, and Flamingo, Ice and Seagull for the Phoenix. Masks are read from your helmet or inventory. The Phoenix is picked up from `/pets` and from Autopet and summon messages.
  - Only shown in dungeons.

## Changed

- **HUD system**
  - Rewritten from scratch. Every HUD element is now placed from a single editor (`/xa hud`): drag to move, scroll to scale, Esc to save.
  - Optional snap grid with an adjustable size, and a "Reset" button, with a confirmation, that puts every element back to its default spot.
  - HUD elements keep the same size whatever your GUI scale is.

- **Players Leaped**
  - Reworked from NoammAddons' leap counter. Tracks SS, EE2, high EE2, EE3, Core, inside Core and the Relic spot.
  - The expected count follows your party size.
  - New "Everyone Leaped!" title when everyone is there, with an editable text, a selectable sound, volume, pitch and a test button.

- **Reminder Gate**
  - New detection: the gate of your Phase 3 section is read straight from the world instead of being guessed from chat messages.
  - No more false reminder when the gate was blown before the first lever, or in the last section, which has no gate.
  - The reminder disappears as soon as the gate goes down.

- **Loadout Title**
  - New "Hide None Parts" option, on by default, that hides the `None` lines from the Pet line down in loadout tooltips.

- **Invincibility Timer**
  - Renamed from "Invisibility Timer".

- **Default modules**
  - On a new config, Cosmetics, Config GUI, ZguegAddons (with all its options) and Command Aliases are now on.
  - Config GUI can no longer be turned off.

## Fixed

- **Item Price**
  - Runes and unique runes now show their Lowest BIN.

## Notes

- The new HUD system resets every HUD position. Place your elements again once with `/xa hud`.
- Because of the rename, Invincibility Timer's settings and HUD position are back to default.

# XenAddons v1.4.10

Minecraft `26.1.2` • Fabric • Java `25+`

## Changed

- **Update Checker**
  - No longer downloads the update automatically. It now shows a chat reminder with a clickable link to the Modrinth page when a newer version is available, so you choose when to update.

- **Custom Names (Cosmetics)**
  - A custom name can now be animated: several color frames smoothly blended into each other, instead of a single static color per letter.
  - Shows up wherever custom names already did — above a player's head and in the tab list.

# XenAddons v1.4.9

Minecraft `26.1.2` • Fabric • Java `25+`

## Added

- **New Category: FISHING**

- **Fishing Hook Display** (FISHING)
  - HUD showing the Hypixel fishing timer (bold, pale yellow) and the pull alert once your hook is ready to be reeled in.
  - The alert text is editable ("Custom Alert Text", `!!!` by default) and always renders bold red, whatever you type in it.
  - Automatically hides the vanilla Hypixel nametag floating above your bobber while the module is on, so you don't see the timer twice.
  - Position and scale are draggable from the HUD editor (`/xa hud`).

- **Hotspot Highlight** (FISHING)
  - Highlights fishing hotspots (Sea Creature, Fishing Speed, Double Hook, Treasure, Trophy Fish, Shard Chance) with a color matching their buff type.
  - Renders an outline and/or a filled surface circle at the water's surface, each with its own opacity slider.
  - Hides the hotspot's spawn particles automatically while the module is on.

- **Hide Other Bobbers** (FISHING)
  - Hides every other player's fishing bobber, so only yours is ever visible.

- **Highlight Pressure Plate** (DUNGEONS)
  - Highlights the Light Weighted Pressure Plate at the I4 room's fixed spot in green, only while it's actually pressed.
  - Only active while in a dungeon.

releases.notes:
# XenAddons v1.4.8

Minecraft `26.1.2` • Fabric • Java `25+`

## Added

- **Warps Shortcuts** (MISC)
  - Warp with `/desert` instead of `/warp desert`. The shortcuts are real client commands, so they show up in autocompletion.
  - A shortcut can point somewhere else than its own name: `/atoll` warps to `lotus`, `/ch` to `crystals`, `/wolf` to `howl`.
  - The list comes from `api.xenus.fr/v1/skyblock/warpshortcuts`, fetched once per launch, with `assets/xenaddons/skyblock/warpShortcuts.json` bundled as fallback if the API is unreachable.
  - Turning the module off hides the shortcuts from autocompletion and sends what you typed to the server untouched, instead of swallowing it.
  - A shortcut whose name is already used by another XenAddons command is skipped, so nothing you already have gets overridden.

- **Farming Tools Keys** (MISC)
  - Gives you separate forward, back, left, right, and break keys while you hold a farming tool, so you no longer have to edit your controls when you farm.
  - Only in the Garden, and only while the tool is in hand. Switch to anything else and your normal keys are back.
  - A toggle keybind (unbound by default) turns the module on and off in game, with a chat line telling you which way it went.

- **Mute Bark Rune** (DUNGEONS)
  - Mutes the wolf growl and bark sounds played by the Bark Rune, with an "Only in Dungeons" option on by default.

- **Cosmetics: Custom Wings** (DEV)
  - Dragon wings on players who have them, with a size and a color read per player from the cosmetics API.
  - Sits behind its own "Custom Wings" toggle in the Cosmetics module.

## Changed

- **Loadout Title**
  - New "Highlight Active Loadout" option, on by default, tinting the background of the equipped loadout in the `/loadout` menu.
  - The highlight is a background behind the item, not an outline drawn over it, so the icon stays readable.
  - The color is a picker, apple green by default.

- **Pet Level**
  - The level text now has its own color picker.

- **Item Price**
  - Lowest BIN is no longer shown when you hover an item in the `/loadout` menu.

## Notes

- Warps Shortcuts is off by default, like every other module. The shortcut list refreshes on game start only.

# XenAddons v1.3.5

Minecraft `1.21.11` • Fabric

## Added

- **Click GUI**
  - New NanoVG-based config GUI.
  - Improved search matching across feature names, settings, options, and keywords.
  - Better HUD editor access from the config menu.

- **Cosmetics**
  - Updated bundled fallback cosmetics snapshot.

## Changed

- **Inventory Buttons**
  - Renamed `InvButtons` to `Inventory Buttons`.
  - Added compatibility for the old config entry name.

- **Experimentation Table**
  - Renamed `Experimentation Table Solver` to `Exp Table Addons`.
  - Removed Chronomatron, Ultrasequencer, and Superpairs solver behavior.
  - Kept only the `Keep Items Visible` option.

- **Build**
  - Release artifacts now include the Minecraft version in the archive name.

## Fixed

- **Spotify Overlay**
  - Fixed Windows title decoding for Russian and other special characters.
  - Improved truncation so special characters are not split mid-character.

- **Cosmetics**
  - Added a 30s cooldown to the refresh button to prevent spam.

- **GUI**
  - Improved config menu sizing and category drag bounds.

- **1.21.11 Compatibility**
  - Cleaned up render, chat, camera, sound, and cooldown compatibility code.
